column1: # Community images pinned for this stack. Update a row when that project
# publishes a newer stable tag that this stack can run. locked=yes rows are
# the release lock. Their scan is recorded and does not block while the lock
# digest is that tag. A different digest blocks the release until the pin is
# upgraded. Postgres stays on the latest 15 release so existing data
# directories open. Elasticsearch stays on the latest 8.19 release because
# the application client is the 8.x client.
